scope: Actual Vue App/WorkspaceHome/WorkSessionBar/transfer dialog; generated simulated IPC/file dialog adapter, not installed or native user-input acceptance
checks: actual import previews ready/missing files; quota failure keeps input and records, retry saves metadata without replacing or persisting the original dirty document
reimporting the same source uses its original fingerprint and does not duplicate or rename the existing record
export excludes optional private search/reference by default; existing destination errors preserve the dialog and an explicit new destination can include chosen context
restore rejects an outside replacement, accepts a real inside replacement, persists only the repair and preserves the exact dirty model and active editor
an actual pending-save ownership guard blocks scene changes before any new native preflight
partial restore keeps missing entries in the named record; a position-storage failure never replaces the live document, and retry can continue the available files
six styles at wide/narrow keep the original import controls and fixed footer reachable, with native modal keyboard dismissal
a library change retires an in-flight preflight; the late reply cannot import into the new library or reopen the closed dialog
